tagline: Take control of your personal finances.
description: Double-entry personal finance manager for accounts, budgets, categories, bills, and reports. Supports imports, rules, multiple currencies, and recurring transactions.

tips.before_install: The first visit creates the admin account. Change `APP_KEY` and `STATIC_CRON_TOKEN` in the app settings before exposing Firefly outside your LAN. The cron container handles recurring transactions and bills.

author: WisdomSky
